title: Grant v6 remaining-stage rehearsal (split, Off, restart; 24h)
problem: The remaining unattended-production proof stages require an explicitly bounded live authorization after fixture preparation; a generic production activation would be too broad.
desired_effect: After fail-closed preconditions, activate a 24-hour policy pinned to the inactive revision recorded by v6 preparation, scoped only to the two named v6 fixture Actions, codex-cli, concurrency one, and the existing packet-approval/integration transitions. It intentionally does not execute the split, Off, or restart observation.

does: Requires the prepared fixture manifest and exact inactive policy revision
Permits codex-cli only, effective concurrency one, and exactly the split and Off fixture Actions
Records the preview, activation, and receipt
never_does: Never grants another Project, Plan, Action, provider, or concurrency
Never launches or terminates a Session itself
Never turns production Off, restarts the worker, merges, deploys, changes credentials, or presses any other approval

success.effect: One scoped, expiring v6 policy is active and its receipt names the only admitted Actions.
success.next: Use morning-runbook.md to observe the first Session, terminate it only after its first partial marker, observe the resumed Session, then perform Off and worker-restart while the second Action is already admitted.

failure.effect: Before activation, policy remains unchanged; after activation, the receipt and production status define the only safe recovery path.
failure.next: Do not press again blindly. Read the timestamped handoff and verify policy status first.
